verdict.rationale: Three.js ships first-party addons that act as ready-made tools and plugins: GLTFLoader, OrbitControls, TransformControls, and SVG/CSS3D renderers. It also offers an official editor, a devtools extension, and a large examples gallery. Its npm package draws over 12M weekly downloads, which signals a broad user base. However, the evidence never shows an asset store, a curated library of ready-made models, or a documented third-party plugin ecosystem; the only community pointer is one developer's open-source games on GitHub. Missing for 10: an asset store or marketplace for ready-made models, evidence of a third-party plugin/package ecosystem, and independent corroboration of ecosystem breadth.
